$comment: Tier-to-vault map the agent builder reads at run time (apps/agent-builder/src/tiers.ts) and the sign-in script uses for the role to pick.
Each tier names one NetSuite role, its write tools and the Managed Agents vault holding that role's sign-in. The builder refuses write tools a tier does not list.

Since platform checkpoint S1 (amendment A13) role permissions are defined, generated and deployed only in dja0086/suitereact-mcp (roles/ and sdf/objects/role/); this file holds no permissions. See docs/adr/0009-roles-move-to-the-platform-repo.md.

tiers.label: Read-only
tiers.description: Reads clients, vendors, items and transactions; cannot change anything.

tiers.label: Clerk
tiers.description: Everything Read-only can, plus creating and updating clients, each after approval.
